text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Members of the Many Many Memories
Club, what
memory should we make
next?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, since when did I join that club?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You mean like that time you put on a
Machan
puppet show for the kids in the
park, or when
everyone did the Umapyoi
Legend dance in the
courtyard?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Since I don't have to explain, we
can
focus our energy on creating
memories with the
biggest impact.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oof, this is a bit too embarrassing for
me, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't think we have to do anything
too
special. Perhaps we can just hang
out like usual,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? Oh yeah! Let's just do things like
normal,
and something memorable is
bound to happen!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm, something out of the ordinary... Oh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How about a game of "No-Holds Barred,
Disguise
and Bribe Your Way to the Top
Kick the Can
Survival"?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well that does sound pretty... Pretty
lit, now
that you mention it.
